content_sections.heading: ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS), Sri Vijaya Puram has released the Recruitment Notification 2026 for 43 vacancies across various posts. Eligible candidates with Class XII, Diploma, Bachelor’s or Master’s qualifications, as prescribed for each post, can apply online up to 25.09.2026. The notification provides details on vacancies, qualifications, age limit, salary, eligibility, and application procedure. Download ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: No separate application start date, admit card date, or exam date is mentioned in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention the number of vacancies for any of the five posts. Candidates should refer to the official NHSRC website for updates on vacancy numbers.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Only full-time regular bachelor's degrees (minimum 3 years) and full-time regular postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2 years) are considered. Diploma, certificate, executive programmes, and qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time, or correspondence mode are not considered. Only post-qualification experience is counted. Desirable qualification for the Consultant, Senior Consultant, and Legal Consultant posts includes contributions to published articles, documents, reports, chapters, or monographs. The Advisor post also lists published work in health systems or public health as desirable.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The fee offered within each band is commensurate with the candidate's qualification and experience. In addition to remuneration, NHSRC Consultants are entitled to free accidental insurance, subsidized medical insurance, mobile bill reimbursement, laptop reimbursement (as per NHSRC policy), 30 days consolidated leave, fully paid maternity leave for female consultants (as per Government of India policy), performance-linked increments, and TA/ DA plus per diem for on-duty visits. The Advisor (PHA) post additionally includes a dedicated sedan car.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification states that if the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. If two or more candidates qualify with the same marks, all such candidates will be considered for further stages. Beyond this written test condition, no other specific selection stages (such as interview details or weightage) are mentioned in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill the online application correctly, available on the official NHSRC website. Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format; no other mode of application is mentioned.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Apply Online - Steps
content_sections.text: Visit the official NHSRC website (nhsrcindia.org). Locate the online application form for the relevant post. Fill in the application form correctly with accurate details. Submit the application in the prescribed online format before the last date. For Advisor (PHA), government officials seeking deputation must also submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their controlling department. Candidates facing difficulty filling the online application form may contact the Principal Administrative Officer, NHSRC, at +91-011-26108982/ 83/ 84/ 92/ 93 between 9:00 AM and 5:30 PM on working days.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Important Notes
content_sections.text: Candidates selected through this recruitment process may also be considered for other vacant positions at NHSRC requiring similar skill sets and at an appropriate level. For the Advisor (PHA) post, government officials willing to come on deputation may also apply, subject to meeting the eligibility criteria and submitting an NOC to NHSRC from their controlling department. Only post-qualification experience is counted for all posts; qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time, or correspondence mode are not considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Consultant - ED Secretariat recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Consultant - ED Secretariat position at NHSRC is 22 September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Consultant - ED Secretariat post?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a full-time MD in Community Medicine/PSM, or an MBBS/BDS degree with a full-time MPH. Additionally, 2 years of post-qualification experience is required for MPH candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Consultant - ED Secretariat position is 45 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Consultant - ED Secretariat role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant - ED Secretariat position ranges from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NHSRC Consultant - ED Secretariat job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official NHSRC website. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading necessary documents, and submitting it before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no mention of an application fee for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant - ED Secretariat position at NHSRC is contract-based.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the NHSRC located?
faq.answer: The NHSRC has its office in New Delhi, and the recruitment is open for positions across India.

faq.question: Q9. Does NHSRC provide age relaxation for any categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any details regarding age relaxation for specific categories. Candidates should refer to the official notification for comprehensive information.
